leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Initialize a dynamic programming array to store the number of ways to decode substrings.
Manipulate the base cases for decoding strings of length 0 and 1.
Apply conditional logic to check if a single digit or two-digit substring forms a valid letter.
Integrate the recurrence relation to compute the total ways for each position in the string.
Construct the final solution by iterating through the input string and updating the DP array.
Render the result by returning the computed number of ways from the last element of the DP array.
